variables.name: XFER_CAP
variables.description: Maximum transfers value on a primary. The check fails above this. Remediation writes this value for transfers and transfers-out.

variables.name: XFER_PER_NS_CAP
variables.description: Maximum transfers-per-ns. The check fails above this.

variables.name: XFER_IN_CAP
variables.description: Maximum transfers-in. The check fails above this.

variables.name: KEY_MAX_AGE_DAYS
variables.description: Maximum DNSSEC key age in days. The check fails above this.

variables.name: LOG_VERSIONS_MIN
variables.description: Minimum number of log file versions. The check fails below this. Remediation writes this value.

variables.name: PRINT_SEVERITY
variables.description: print-severity value required in logging channels. Remediation writes this value.

variables.name: TSIG_MODES
variables.description: Comma-separated modes accepted for TSIG key files.

variables.name: KEYGEN_MODE
variables.description: Mode required for dnssec-keygen key files.

variables.name: LOG_SEVERITY
variables.description: Comma-separated logging severities the check accepts. Remediation writes the first value.

variables.name: LISTEN_PORT
variables.description: DNS listen port. The check fails when listen-on uses another port.

variables.name: DNSSEC_MODES
variables.description: Comma-separated modes accepted for DNSSEC key files.
